source: union of the 11 FHIR R4 resources in sub-set E

columns.name: Condition.clinicalStatus
columns.desc: active | recurrence | relapse | inactive | remission | resolved

columns.name: Condition.verificationStatus
columns.desc: unconfirmed | provisional | differential | confirmed | refuted | entered-in-error

columns.name: Condition.code
columns.desc: Identification of the condition, problem or diagnosis

columns.name: Condition.onset[x]
columns.desc: Estimated or actual date,  date-time, or age

columns.name: DiagnosticReport.subject
columns.desc: The subject of the report - usually, but not always, the patient

columns.name: DiagnosticReport.encounter
columns.desc: Health care event when test ordered

columns.name: DiagnosticReport.specimen
columns.desc: Specimens this report is based on

columns.name: DiagnosticReport.imagingStudy
columns.desc: Reference to full details of imaging associated with the diagnostic report

columns.name: DiagnosticReport.media
columns.desc: Key images associated with this report

columns.name: DiagnosticReport.conclusionCode
columns.desc: Codes for the clinical conclusion of test results

columns.name: Encounter.identifier
columns.desc: Identifier(s) by which this encounter is known

columns.name: Encounter.status
columns.desc: planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled +

columns.name: Encounter.statusHistory.status
columns.desc: planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled +

columns.name: Encounter.statusHistory.period
columns.desc: The time that the episode was in the specified status

columns.name: Encounter.classHistory.period
columns.desc: The time that the episode was in the specified class

columns.name: Encounter.priority
columns.desc: Indicates the urgency of the encounter

columns.name: Encounter.subject
columns.desc: The patient or group present at the encounter

columns.name: Encounter.episodeOfCare
columns.desc: Episode(s) of care that this encounter should be recorded against

columns.name: Encounter.basedOn
columns.desc: The ServiceRequest that initiated this encounter

columns.name: Encounter.participant
columns.desc: List of participants involved in the encounter

columns.name: Encounter.participant.period
columns.desc: Period of time during the encounter that the participant participated

columns.name: Encounter.participant.individual
columns.desc: Persons involved in the encounter other than the patient

columns.name: Encounter.appointment
columns.desc: The appointment that scheduled this encounter

columns.name: Encounter.period
columns.desc: The start and end time of the encounter

columns.name: Encounter.length
columns.desc: Quantity of time the encounter lasted (less time absent)

columns.name: Encounter.reasonCode
columns.desc: Coded reason the encounter takes place

columns.name: Encounter.diagnosis
columns.desc: The list of diagnosis relevant to this encounter

columns.name: Encounter.diagnosis.condition
columns.desc: The diagnosis or procedure relevant to the encounter

columns.name: Encounter.diagnosis.use
columns.desc: Role that this diagnosis has within the encounter (e.g. admission, billing, discharge …)

columns.name: Encounter.diagnosis.rank
columns.desc: Ranking of the diagnosis (for each role type)

columns.name: Encounter.account
columns.desc: The set of accounts that may be used for billing for this Encounter

columns.name: Encounter.hospitalization
columns.desc: Details about the admission to a healthcare service

columns.name: Encounter.hospitalization.origin
columns.desc: The location/organization from which the patient came before admission

columns.name: Encounter.hospitalization.admitSource
columns.desc: From where patient was admitted (physician referral, transfer)

columns.desc: The type of hospital re-admission that has occurred (if any). If the value is absent, then this is not identified as a readmission

columns.name: Encounter.hospitalization.dietPreference
columns.desc: Diet preferences reported by the patient

columns.name: Encounter.hospitalization.destination
columns.desc: Location/organization to which the patient is discharged

columns.name: Encounter.hospitalization.dischargeDisposition
columns.desc: Category or kind of location after discharge

columns.name: Encounter.location
columns.desc: List of locations where the patient has been

columns.name: Encounter.location.physicalType
columns.desc: The physical type of the location (usually the level in the location hierachy - bed room ward etc.)

columns.name: Encounter.location.period
columns.desc: Time period during which the patient was present at the location

columns.name: Encounter.serviceProvider
columns.desc: The organization (facility) responsible for this encounter

columns.name: Encounter.partOf
columns.desc: Another Encounter this encounter is part of

columns.name: Location.identifier
columns.desc: Unique code or number identifying the location to its users

columns.name: Location.operationalStatus
columns.desc: The operational status of the location (typically only for a bed/room)

columns.name: Location.name
columns.desc: Name of the location as used by humans

columns.name: Location.alias
columns.desc: A list of alternate names that the location is known as, or was known as, in the past

columns.name: Location.description
columns.desc: Additional details about the location that could be displayed as further information to identify the location beyond its name

columns.name: Location.managingOrganization
columns.desc: Organization responsible for provisioning and upkeep

columns.name: Location.partOf
columns.desc: Another Location this one is physically a part of

columns.desc: What days/times during a week is this location usually open

columns.name: Location.hoursOfOperation.daysOfWeek
columns.desc: mon | tue | wed | thu | fri | sat | sun

columns.desc: The Location is open all day

columns.desc: Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the location

columns.desc: Condition or observation that supports why the prescription is being written

columns.desc: Composite request this is part of

columns.desc: How the medication should be taken

columns.desc: Number of days supply per dispense

columns.desc: Date/Time this version was made available
